title: Clean and summarize a large sharded CSV dataset
task: Implement a streaming program that reads all CSV shards, validates records, normalizes email addresses and timestamps, removes duplicate record IDs, and writes valid records sorted by event_time plus a JSON summary. Do not load the full dataset into memory.
checks: output schema matches the task contract
valid and rejected row counts match the reference
normalized values satisfy the documented invariants
output is ordered by event_time then record_id
peak memory stays within the configured limit
